meta.name: gtars
meta.description: High-performance toolkit for genomic interval analysis in Rust with Python bindings. Use when working with genomic regions, BED files, coverage tracks, overlap detection, tokenization for ML models, or fragment analysis in computational genomics and machine learning applications.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析基因组区间与BED文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理基因组区域、覆盖度或片段分析。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze genomic intervals and BED files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with genomic regions, coverage, or fragment analysis.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以处理基因组区间数据，例如查找重叠区域、生成覆盖度轨迹、将基因组区域转换为机器学习用的 token，以及管理参考序列。
howto.when: 当你提到 BED 文件、基因组区间、覆盖度轨迹、或需要为基因组机器学习预处理数据时触发。

say.text: 帮我找出这两个 BED 文件中的重叠区域。
say.note: Claude 会调用 gtars 进行重叠检测。

say.text: 用这个 BED 文件生成 BigWig 覆盖度轨迹。
say.note: Claude 会使用 uniwig 模块生成覆盖度文件。

say.text: 将这段基因组区域转换为机器学习 token。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can process genomic interval data, such as finding overlapping regions, generating coverage tracks, converting genomic regions into tokens for machine learning, and managing reference sequences.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention BED files, genomic intervals, coverage tracks, or need to preprocess genomic data for machine learning.

say_en.text: Find overlapping regions between these two BED files.
say_en.note: Claude will use gtars for overlap detection.

say_en.text: Generate a BigWig coverage track from this BED file.
say_en.note: Claude will use the uniwig module to generate coverage.

say_en.text: Tokenize this genomic region for machine learning.
say_en.note: Claude will use TreeTokenizer for tokenization.
